description_en: Adds local compute nodes to a hybrid cloud cluster or a cloud cluster
description_zh: 增加本地计算节点到混合云集群或者云上集群
name: AddLocalNodes

parameters.help_en: A JSON-formatted string that contains the information about the local compute nodes. The information includes the HostName, IpAddress, CpuCores, and Memory (in MB) of each node
parameters.help_zh: 本地计算节点信息。JSON格式的字符串，包含本地节点的HostName、IpAddress、CpuCores、Memory（单位MB）
parameters.name: nodes

parameters.help_en: The scheduler queue to which the local compute nodes are added
parameters.help_zh: 本地计算节点所加入的调度器队列信息
parameters.name: queue
